title: "Agro_data"
format: html

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("sf")
library("here")
library("mapview")
library("RColorBrewer")
```

```{r}
ag_2015 <- st_read(here("Data/Land_Use_2015_Baseline.geojson"))
ag_2020 <- st_read(here("Data/Land_Use_2020_Update.geojson"))
```

```{r}
#make a map
mapview(ag_2015, zcol = "cropcatego")
# RColorBrewer can make better
```

Distribution of Acrage

```{r}
ggplot(ag_2015, aes(x = acreage)) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~island, scales = "free_y")
```

Questions:

Did we add/lose ag land acrage between 2015 and 2020

```{r}
sum_2015_acrage <- sum(ag_2015$acreage)
sum_2020_acrage <- sum(ag_2020$acreage)
sum_2020_acrage - sum_2015_acrage
```
